'''Smithing''' in Matcha Flavoured upgrades base equipment into [[alloy]] equipment at a [[Smithing Table|smithing table]]. The vanilla netherite recipes are blocked.

== Alloy upgrades ==
Each upgrade is a smithing transform with an empty template slot: base item + alloy → alloy item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_pickaxe.json}}</ref> The smithing table's template slot tooltip is renamed "Add Smithing Template or Leave Empty".
* Iron gear + [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] → [[Steel equipment|steel]]
* Copper gear + [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo]] or [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]] → [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] or [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]]
* Diamond gear + [[Electrum Alloy|electrum]] or [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]] → [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] or [[Adamant equipment|adamant]]
* Elytra + shakudo or hepatizon alloy → [[Elytra|alloy elytra]]

=== Hybrid upgrades ===
[[Mattock]]s, [[dolabra]]s and [[claymore]]s need a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]]. The recipes check only the item ID of the base, so the template, not the base, decides the result: a diamond axe with the template becomes a dolabra, and a diamond dolabra without it becomes an axe.

=== Other smithing ===
* [[Silver Sword]], [[Warding Sword]] and [[Warding Shield]].
* Armor [[Trims|trims]], using [[Smithing Trim Color|smithing trim colors]].

== Enchantments ==
The result keeps the base item's enchantments; the alloy's intrinsics are added, and where both have the same enchantment the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/select_higher_level.mcfunction}}</ref> The tier stats are replaced by the new item's.
